name: Hand Disable
description: SpongeBob can disable Hans using any taxipad in the Bikini Bottom hub world. This allows the player to traverse many previously out-of-bounds areas.

name: Climb Squidward's House
description: SpongeBob can climb Squidward’s house to reach the golden underwear and On Top of the Pineapple, skipping the two buttons that spawn the platforms.

name: Shady Glide
description: Using a cruise boost and an ascending sponge-glide, SpongeBob can jump across the top of the invisible walls and make it to the top of Shady Shoals. This strategy is used in Restricted Cheat% categories (i.e., Early Powers).

name: Shoals SDJ
description: Using the SpongeBall located in the first hub area, SpongeBob can reach the Shady Shoals spatula using an SDJ. This can be setup using either the floating tiki’s near Bubble Buddy, or the floating platform near Patrick. NOTE: Music cycles are different between Xbox Disc and Xbox HDD.

name: Rollbuck
spatula: On Top of the Chum Bucket
description: Using SpongeBall storage, SpongeBob can roll up and across the wall into the third hub area early, bypassing Robo-Patrick and collecting On Top of the Chum Bucket.

name: Fast Buck
spatula: On Top of the Chum Bucket
description: Using a one-frame double jump out of a damage boost,, SpongeBob can jump across the wall into the third hub area early, bypassing Robo-Patrick and collecting On Top of the Chum Bucket.

name: Midbuck
spatula: On Top of the Chum Bucket
description: Using SpongeBall storage, SpongeBob can roll from the police station into the third hub area early, bypassing Robo-Patrick and collecting On Top of the Chum Bucket.

name: Police Jump
spatula: On Top of the Chum Bucket
description: From on top of the police station, Spongebob can jump over the wall into the third hub area by double jumping and spinning.

name: Police Station CB
spatula: On Top of the Chum Bucket

name: Spatula Overlap
description: After completing the fight and leaving the Krusty Krab, SpongeBob can purchase a spatula from Mr. Krabs at the same time as collecting the reward. Both spatulas are collected simultaneously, skipping a spatula animation.

name: Wall Jump Skip
spatula: A Wall Jump in the Bucket

name: CB Wall Jump
spatula: A Wall Jump in the Bucket

name: Bucket SAS
spatula: A Wall Jump in the Bucket

name: Hub Glide
description: With a cruise boost, SpongeBob can glide over the invisible wall and bypass Robo-Sandy and enter the second hub area.

name: Robo-Sandy Skip (RSS)
description: By jumping under an out-of-bounds invisible wall, SpongeBob can bypass the invisible wall blocking the second hub area.

name: Bring it Around Town
description: By activating Save Game Glitch, SpongeBob can walk on the out of bounds sand without being grabbed by Hans and walk around the invisible walls to reach the second hub area.

name: Hub One VMS
description: By using the copper platforms or thunder tiki stack in Downtown and pausing at a specific time to set up VMS, you can jump over the Hub One wall avoiding the Hans trigger. Used in No Hand Disable.

name: Hammer Skip
description: SpongeBob can manipulate the Ham-mer robot to move into a certain position. By jumping off of its head into the goo puddle, SpongeBob can launch himself higher than normal and reach the top of the cliff, skipping a large portion of the level.

name: Rock Climb
description: SpongeBob can climb Jellyfish Rock early, collecting the sock and skipping a large portion of the level.

name: Cowa Skip
description: SpongeBob can bypass the Hans trigger and collect the spatula early, unlocking the spatula’s warp. Going to the warp skips a large portion of the level.

name: Under the Caves
description: SpongeBob can skip going through the caves platforming segment by using a cruise boost to jump out of bounds from Patrick's dilemma area to go under the caves.

name: Rock Skip
description: Using cruise boost movement, SpongeBob can use the stalagmite to optimally reach the Spelunking spatula.

name: Dilemma Skip
description: Using the Duplicatotron’s explosion, SpongeBob can damage boost himself to Patrick, skipping the robot fight.

name: Pat’s Hammer
description: Using the Ham-mer’s damage, SpongeBob can damage boost himself to Patrick, skipping the robot fight.

name: CB Dilemma Right/Left
description: Using cruise boost movement, SpongeBob can reach Patrick, skipping the robot fight.

name: Drain the Lake Clip
description: Using a cruise boost and lag clipping, SpongeBob can clip through the ground and collect the Drain the Lake spatula.

name: Rooftops Bowl Boost
description: Instead of jumping across the buildings, SpongeBob can perform a Hans Bowl Boost off of a certain checkpoint to reach the Lighthouse entrance and the rooftops spatula.

name: Cruise Boost Needle
spatula: Come Back with the Cruise Bubble

name: CBWTCB SAS
spatula: Come Back with the Cruise Bubble

name: CB Kids
description: Using a cruise boost, SpongeBob can meet a cycle and quickly save all five of the children.

name: LCB Kids
description: Using a ledge cruise boost, SpongeBob can meet a cycle and quickly save all five of the children.

name: Moat Bowl
description: There is an invisible button that becomes visible upon paying the clam. Despite it being invisible, it can still be activated if pressed. Moat Bowl launched a bowl from the castle, hitting the button and revealing the spatula.

name: Under the Moat
description: The Over the Moat spatula is available by default underneath the goo, waiting to be brought above the goo. But here is an L-clip spot located just inside the door to the sand castle. Once out of bounds, SpongeBob can navigate towards the spatula and grab it early.

name: Pier Slide Jump
spatula: Slip n' Slide Under the Pier

name: Pier SAS
spatula: Slip n' Slide Under the Pier

name: Pier Slide Slam
spatula: Slip n' Slide Under the Pier

name: Dome Clip
description: By bashing underneath Robo-Sandy as she slams the ground, SpongeBob can clip beneath the stage and collect the spatula. This does not unlock the bubble bowl.

name: Dome Lag Clip
description: Using pause lag, SpongeBob can clip beneath the stage and collect the spatula. This does not unlock the bubble bowl.

name: Tiki Bash
description: Using cruise boost movement, SpongeBob can bash onto the shh-tikis to reach the museum.

name: Cliff Bash
description: Using cruise boost movement, SpongeBob can bash onto a small ledge to reach the museum.

name: Art CCA
description: By having EXACTLY six other collectibles from another level, SpongeBob can warp from there to Rock Bottom, press L on the first frame you load in, and trick Ms. Puff into thinking you have all six paintings.

name: Art Glide
description: Using an LCB, SpongeBob can activate a Sponge-Glide underneath the map to collect the debug purple shiny object, completing the objective.

name: Art Bash
description: Using an LCB, SpongeBob can store downward momentum and perform a precise bash to collect the debug purple shiny object, completing the objective.

name: Art Lag Clip
description: By getting a cruise boost and using pause lag, Spongebob will fall under the road and can grab the debug purple shiny object, completing the objective.

name: Bob Museum
spatula: Plundering the Robots in the Museum

name: Sandy Museum
spatula: Plundering the Robots in the Museum

name: Trash Bash
spatula: Plundering the Robots in the Museum

name: Misc. Bob Museum (Powerless)
spatula: Plundering the Robots in the Museum

name: Sleepy Skip
spatula: How In Tarnation Do You Get There?
description: By using a slide bash damage boost, Spongbob can reach the platform where the spatula is located.

name: CB Tarnation (+Busstop variation)
spatula: How In Tarnation Do You Get There?

name: Sandy Tarnation
spatula: How In Tarnation Do You Get There?

name: LCB Cam Lock
spatula: How In Tarnation Do You Get There?
description: Using the trench LCB spot near Gary, Spongebob has enough speed to grab the spatula and spin around during the animation without falling off. This is only fast if the LCB is useful elsewhere, e.g. getting trench art or lasers.

name: CB Segment
spatula: Lasers Are Fun and Good For You

name: Lasers Cutscene Skip
spatula: Lasers Are Fun and Good For You

name: LCB Lasers
spatula: Lasers Are Fun and Good For You
description: On a rock near Gary, there is an LCB spot that gives 11-13 bowling speeds. This LCB makes reaching the lasers as Spongebob much faster than with a regular cruise boost. This segment combined with Tarnation Cam Lock saves over 24 seconds in hundo and 34 seconds in ALS.

name: Lasers Bowl Boost
spatula: Lasers Are Fun and Good For You

name: Lobby Ledge Grab
description: SpongeBob can grab the ledge of the upper area, skipping most of the level.

name: Security Tunnel Skip
description: There are two cliff to climb. The first one is climbed by jumping off of a small ledge on the wall. The second one is climbed by bashing into the electricity, giving SpongeBob his jump back soon enough to land on the turret. From the turret, you can reach the end and collect the spatula. Although the bowl is not required to perform this strat, you need it to press one of the four main buttons for Shut Down the Security System.

name: Ball Room Clip (L-Bowl)
description: Using an L-Bowl between the cage and the wall, SpongeBob can clip inside the cage.

name: Ball Room Clip (L-Clip)
description: SpongeBob can derail the rolling ball and guide it towards the cage. He can clip inside of it and guide it towards Mr. Krabs. At a specific position, SpongeBob can do an L-Clip when the ball and Mr. Krabs overlap, clipping inside the cage.

name: Prawn Skip
description: With a cruise boost, SpongeBob can L-clip out of bounds and climb the outside of the map. From there, SpongeBob can jump to the debug trigger to end the Prawn fight. NOTE: On GameCube, touching the trigger will NOT teleport you back into the map beside the spatula. Getting back inside can be done by reloading the level or ledge grabbing back into the map.

name: Prawn Early
description: Going to the same spot where SpongeBob L-Clips out for Prawn Skip, he can also clip out of bounds by reaching a specific spot either by bowling or spinning into it. Once this is done,0 SpongeBob can jump to clip out, and from there he has several options: a ledge bowl jump, a precise double-jump-spin-slam, or ramping a bowling ball and bashing on top of it. Either of these reach the trigger.

name: Prawn SAS
description: The spatula animation for the Prawn spatula can be skipped by bowling into the spatula, quickly pressing R to enter the Main Chamber, and performing an L-Cancel the first frame you load in. This can be followed up by firing the cruise bubble at the security button near Barnacle Boy. The SAS can also be performed with a 1-frame R press.

name: Fence Bowl
description: By bowling into the fence, you can rebound the bowl and use it to reach the Frosty Bungee.

name: Frosty Clam Skip
description: SpongeBob bypasses the Hans trigger and collects Frosty Bungee.

name: Guppy LCB
spatula: Defeat the Robots on Guppy Mound
description: There are two LCB spots at the start of the slide that can be utilized to collect the Guppy Mound spatulas and socks.

name: Guppy Clip
spatula: Defeat the Robots on Guppy Mound
description: Using the high speed Guppy LCB, SpongeBob can clip out of bounds and skip the entire slide.

name: Guppy Casual/Billboard Skip
spatula: Defeat the Robots on Guppy Mound

name: Dupe Trickshot
spatula: Defeat the Robots on Guppy Mound

name: Dupe Damage Boost
spatula: Defeat the Robots on Guppy Mound

name: Guppy LCB
description: There are two LCB spots at the start of the slide that can be utilized to collect the Guppy Mound spatulas and socks.

name: Guppy Clip
description: Using the high speed Guppy LCB, SpongeBob can clip out of bounds and skip the entire slide.

name: Larry Slide Skip
description: Larry’s slide is the third and final slide in Sand Mountain. Larry challenges you to a time challenge, and there are robots at the end to defeat. Each objective rewards a spatula. Out of bounds near the top of the slide, SpongeBob can do an L-Bowl on a certain ledge. Due to Larry's Slide being U-shaped, this sends SpongeBob straight from the top to the bottom of the slide. SpongeBob can cruise boost to skip defeating the robots.

name: Campers CCA
description: By having six or more other collectibles from another level, SpongeBob can warp from there to Kelp Forest, press L on the first frame you load in, and trick Ms. Puff into thinking you have all six campers.

name: OOB Crystals
description: By using a ledge grab on a rock to clip out of bounds, SpongeBob can use cruise boost movement to grab all six crystals and the caves camper much faster than lowering the gates and solving the puzzles.

name: Vine Climb
description: The plate above the cliff near Barnacle Boy causes a tall vine with leaf trampolines to grow, allowing you to get to the top of the level to the highest crystal. Before the vine grows after activating it, a part of the vine is already sticking out of the ground, including a trampoline leaf. Using the leaf, SpongeBob can jump up to the top of the vine, performing a precise bash. From there, SpongeBob lands on a small ledge above. Spongebob can continue to bash up the wall to the top of the level, leading to one of the five crystals.

name: Lake Sock
description: SpongeBob can reach this sock using cruise boost jump spacing without the need for Sandy.

name: Goo Cage Bash
description: Using the bubble bowl, SpongeBob can launch a bowl on top of the cage, run underneath it before it lands, and perform a bash when the ball lands on him. This causes SpongeBob to dip low enough to collect the spatula.

name: Goo Cage Clip
description: Using the bubble bowl, SpongeBob can launch a bowl next to the cage, run in front of it before it lands, and perform an L-Bowl when the ball lands on him. This causes SpongeBob to clip inside the cage.

name: Goo Cage Lag Clip
description: By getting a cruise boost and lag clipping, Spongebob can fall through the ceiling of the cage and collect the spatula.

name: Boat Bash
spatula: Top of the Stack of Ships

name: Window Bash
spatula: Top of the Stack of Ships

name: Wall Jump VMS
spatula: Top of the Stack of Ships

name: Misc. Hell Glide
spatula: Top of the Stack of Ships

name: Oil Skip
description: Using the Slick’s oil shot, Spongebob can damage boost and perform a sliding bash to reach the Dreamscape spatula.

name: Quick Slick
description: Instead of taking time to set up a sliding bash, SpongeBob can instead get a damage boost off the Slick's barrier and do a 1-Frame jump to reach the spatula's island. The traditional setup is to do this trick right after 1-Frame Forbidden Skip, in order to have the cycle for the Slick aligned.

name: CB Dreamscape
description: Using cruise boost movement, SpongeBob can jump straight to the Dreamscape spatula.

name: Forbidden Skip
description: By bowling on the spikes of a specific floating block, SpongeBob can damage boost over to the spatula quicker than walking down the planks.

name: Forbidden 1-Frame
description: Using another spikebowl on a lower block, SpongeBob can perform a one frame double jump to reach the spatula quicker. This method is among the fastest strats as it can reach the proper cycle for another trick called Quick Slick.

name: Sandy Nut
description: Sandy can glide over to the edge of the giant acorn. By jumping into a small part of the invisible checkpoint, Sandy can proceed to die and respawn on top of the nut.

name: Fast Nut
description: Using a cruise boost and a one-frame slide bash, SpongeBob can reach the top of the giant acorn.

name: Thunder Nut
description: Spongebob can get stuck in between the thunder tikis near the starting platform. From there, Spongebob must perform a precise DBB at the moment the tikis explode, so that the momentum gets transferred to a damage boost. Then, Spongebob can perform a 1-frame bash to reach the spatula.

name: Swingerless
description: Located at the Sandy’s Dream exit is a DCB spot. SpongeBob can activate this and reach the Sliding Texas Style. From here, Spongebob can either get a ledge grab and camera lock the spatula or open the box and get it later as Sandy.

name: Swingerless
description: Located at the Sandy’s Dream exit is a DCB spot. SpongeBob can activate this and traverse through the level collecting all the collectibles in Sandy’s Dream much faster than Sandy.

name: Swingers BBJ
description: After collecting Sliding Texas Style, SpongeBob can jump up the slide with cruise boost momentum to reach a checkpoint. Then, Spongebob can get grabbed by Hans and perform a Bowl Boost Jump to reach Swingers Ahoy without paying the clam.

spatula: Music is in the Ear of the Beholder

spatula: Music is in the Ear of the Beholder

spatula: Music is in the Ear of the Beholder

spatula: Music is in the Ear of the Beholder

spatula: Music is in the Ear of the Beholder

name: Cutscene Skip (Reload vs. No Reload)
description: The initial cutscene in Krabs’ Dream showing the robots can be skipped by bowling off the ledge just before the cutscene plays and getting grabbed by Hans.
